I present to you: Two original panels of "The Captain and the Kids" from 1943, by Rudolph Dirks. Links and details in the comments.

I'm sorry for not linking a complete album on imgur, I can't get it to upload properly...

What you see in the link is the source in german. Rudolph Dirks, a pioneer comic artist, is credited with being one of the first artists to introduce the concept of panels to the medium comic and also being the inventor of "seeing stars" to indicate pain and the boot print on the backside long after a kick to the butt. Here are the two promised panels, both 62 year old originals, photographed in early 2015 during the exhibition "Streich um Streich" in Gelsenkirchen, Germany: http://imgur.com/a/KeRCB

I also have a few more pics of historically interesting exhibits, if anyone is interested. The exhibition was about the history of the german comic (Dirks was of german descent and emmigrated to New York, where he helped laying the foundations to the contemporal comics we all know and love). For example: A faximile (early reprint) of the very first german publication that can be considered an ancestor of the comic, "Max and Moritz" by Wilhelm Busch from 1863, a german folk tale that virtually every german knows by heart.

Hello everyone - just a PSA that all Voat apps aren't working at the minute. Basically the Voat server has changed the data it sends back and the apps don't know how to handle it (more specifically, the API appears to be returning XML rather than JSON). I don't know why this is happening or when it will be fixed, hopefully it shouldn't take too long.

So if you were wondering why the website was up but the apps are down, this would be why!

Edit: Seems like some apps are ok, they might be avoiding the affected API entirely

Edit 2: Looks like this has been resolved, apps should be working (for now).
PSA - Voat apps are temporarily down
Unofficial APIs might not be affected in that case. I assumed that all apps out there were using the legacy API to some degree.
Is there any word when the new APIv2 is expected to release? A lot of the big app developers seem to be waiting on it before throwing their hat into the ring

The most optimistic plan was hoping to release it now, but that was before the two Great Server Fires of 2015 happened. My speculative guess would be that it was released within the next couple of weeks/months, depending on how busy PuttItOutPlease is. Probably a good thing as it gives a lot more time for us app developers to include basic functionality in the apps.
From my understanding basic functionality is all that can be included at the moment with the current API. Is that not true?

Theoretically you could do everything that the Voat website currently does, by using its own private API, which is what most of the apps are doing right now. This leaves them vulnerable to any changes made by the website, and also means that when the new API is released the developer would need to invest time in upgrading to that.

Developing with the new API is the conservative option, and it's what most people are doing behind the scenes.
